mapper.select: SELECT lp.subject_type, lp.subject_id, NULL AS "avatar", lp.permission_type, lp.permission_id, lp.granted_by, lp.created_time AS "grantedTime" FROM bt_dc_library_permission lp INNER JOIN bt_dc_document_library l ON l.library_id = lp.library_id AND l.space_id = #{spaceId} WHERE lp.status_cd = #{statusCd} AND lp.library_id = #{libraryId} AND NOT (lp.subject_type = 'USER' AND lp.subject_id = (SELECT creator_id FROM bt_dc_document_library WHERE library_id = #{libraryId} AND status_cd = #{statusCd})) ORDER BY lp.created_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.library_id, a.library_name, a.library_icon, a.description, a.visibility_scope, a.owner_id, a.sort_order, a.access_count, a.last_access_time, a.tenant_id, a.creator_id, a.created_time, a.status_cd, a.color, a.is_builtin, a.space_id, a.updated_time FROM bt_dc_document_library a ,bt_dc_document b WHERE a.library_id = b.library_id AND a.status_cd = '00A' AND b.status_cd = '00A' and b.document_id = #{documentId}
